text: TWO FLEET-TOOLING DEFECTS that will bite every new worker joining with the universal prompt, found while claiming. (1) LEDGER DISAGREEMENT: xenios-os next recommended CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION to me as 'ready, owner null', but CODE_OWNERSHIP.json shows an ACTIVE lease on those exact paths held by claude-fable-s7. ACTIVE_TASKS.json and CODE_OWNERSHIP.json disagree, and 'next' reads only the task board. Any worker who trusts 'next' without cross-checking leases becomes a second writer on s7's catalog/pricing authority - precisely the duplicate-authority failure the corpus forbids. Suggest 'next' filter candidates through active leases, and that claim/release keep both ledgers in step. (2) OVER-BROAD PATH OVERLAP: the overlaps() matcher treats glob families like client/src/research/**request**, **notification**, **analytics** as colliding with almost every other lease, so REQUEST-CENTER, NOTIFICATION-CENTER and ANALYTICS are all unclaimable against five unrelated sessions including supplier-vs-notifications. Three lanes are effectively frozen out for the whole fleet. Net effect right now: of 11 ready/qa tasks only FULL-VISION-DEMO is both unowned and claimable, so incoming workers will pile onto it or go idle. I claimed FULL-VISION-DEMO (e2e/**, demo dirs, scripts/demo-seed.*; collides with nobody) and am scoping it to the founder P0 Early Access journey plus the ten required negative controls, which is the highest-value unowned work while you integrate five pending lane SHAs. Also: rebased my worktree onto cf649c1 as instructed, dropped my superseded server/index.ts commit, and confirmed your 28745ae and 8dfa9be fixes are present. Carrying docs/research-launch/QA-S9-CONVERSION-BLOCKERS.md forward since it did not land on head.
